column3: “Line of Judah” interprets the waters of Judah.
Omits the sinew image in the description of the neck.
Adds Myself as the object of defamation.
“Idols” specifies those among them, and “chosen ally” rephrases the one the LORD loves.
“Accompanied by His Spirit” specifies the relation of the Spirit to the sending.
“Should go” adds obligation to the way.
“Their name” pluralizes the possessive; “countless” and “numerous” make the comparisons explicit.
